summary: The ServiceCode class represents the code and other associated information for services in the HSPnet system. It includes properties like ID, CodeCategoryID, ShortName, Name, and Notes, and provides methods for localization and retrieval by course or timetable ID.
purpose: To represent and manage service codes within the HSPnet application.

workflows.name: Service Code Retrieval
steps: Localize service if alt language fields are used.
